The bird on the right is in profile facing left, displaying prominent red eyebrow combs, glossy black plumage with iridescent sheen, and white undertail coverts fanned out. The bird on the left is partially visible, facing away/right, also showing white tail feathers. Background is a soft-focus blur of warm earth tones.
